title: BlazeRip instance
description: Per-template schema for blaze. Core TemplateConfig fields (theme/global) are $ref-d from the global animations.schema.json. This template does NOT own content — it burns arbitrary `children` passed by the caller, so `elements[]` is unconstrained (any id) and typically empty. extras.* are extended here.

elements.description: Currently unused by blaze itself — content is passed as `children` to <BlazeRip>. Kept in the schema for DeepConfig pipeline compatibility.

height.description: Height of the fire zone as a fraction of the frame height, rising from the bottom. Clamped to a 0.02 minimum

distortion.description: Heat-distortion strength: how strongly the fire zone bends the content beneath it (0 to 3)

distortionScale.description: Spatial scale of the heat-distortion noise. Lower = larger, softer ripples

speed.description: Animation speed multiplier. Fire time advances at `speed` seconds per second of composition time; 0 freezes the fire

sparks.description: Brightness of the rising spark layer (0 disables sparks entirely)

sparkDensity.description: Density of the spark cells — higher packs more sparks into the same area

layers.description: Depth layers of sparks (1 to 10) — more layers give more parallax and density

smoke.description: Intensity of the drifting fbm smoke column (0 disables smoke)

glow.description: Warm glow intensity at the base of the fire

sparkColor.description: Color of the sparks as [r, g, b] in 0-1 range

smokeColor.description: Color of the smoke and base glow as [r, g, b] in 0-1 range

fadeInFrames.description: Treatment fade-in over the first N frames: the fire grows in as a canvas-opacity tape instead of popping over the page

fadeOutFrames.description: Treatment fade-out over the last N frames (canvas opacity)
